results_review_notes: Only the two frozen Table 5 baseline logit models are retained: Model (1) with individual governance proxies and Model (2) with the summary GOV index. The LARGE substitution and all Section 6 supplemental or within-test-sample analyses are excluded.

Table 3 means and proportions for the 64 test and 64 matched control firms are retained as predictor descriptives; its paired-test p-values are excluded from data descriptives. LARGE is omitted because it is not a selected baseline predictor.

Table 3 provides descriptive rows for the selected RHS predictors, but it does not provide a separate descriptive row for FULDISC apart from using FULDISC=0 and FULDISC=1 to define the two groups; no outcome statistic is inferred from those labels.

The source table prints unstandardized logit coefficients and p-values of Wald chi-squares, but no individual Wald statistic, standard error, chi-square degrees of freedom or reference distribution is given. Only printed p-values and stars are retained; none are calculated.

The Table 5 note specifies one-tailed p-values when a coefficient has its expected sign and two-tailed otherwise. Per-term directions use the printed predicted-sign column and the printed coefficient sign; intercepts have no predicted sign and are two-tailed.
